questions.whatIsAnswer: [ZH-CN] Easy Timestamps is a free tool that helps you create professional YouTube timestamps and video chapters quickly and efficiently.
questions.howToUse: [ZH-CN] How do I use Easy Timestamps?
questions.howToUseAnswer: [ZH-CN] Simply paste a YouTube URL or upload a video file, then add timestamps with titles. You can export the results in various formats.
questions.supportedFormatsAnswer: [ZH-CN] We support YouTube URLs and MP4 file uploads. More formats coming soon.
questions.freeToUse: [ZH-CN] Is Easy Timestamps free to use?
questions.freeToUseAnswer: [ZH-CN] Yes! Easy Timestamps is completely free to use with no hidden fees or subscriptions.
questions.exportFormatsAnswer: [ZH-CN] You can export timestamps in YouTube description format, JSON, CSV, and plain text formats.
